headline: 2 of Wall Street’s Favorite Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 We Question
summary: Wall Street is overwhelmingly bullish on the stocks in this article, with price targets suggesting significant upside potential. headline: US Solar Power Just Hit a Record High as AI Data Centers Push Electricity Demand to New Highs
summary: American solar farms are setting records while AI data centers consume power at a pace that could outstrip every new megawatt coming online by 2027. Something has to give, and whoever fills the gap will decide what shows up on your electricity bill.
